text:
In the afternoon are sweet the neons

and the luces of mercurio, pálidas and bellas…

and the estrella roja of a torre of radio

in the sky crepuscular of Managua

is so bonita as Venus

and a anuncio ESSO is as the luna


the lucecitas rojas of the automóviles are místicas

(the alma is as a muchacha besuqueada detrás of a auto)

TACA BUNGE KLM SINGER

MENNEN HTM GOMEZ NORGE

RPM SAF OPTICA SELECTA

proclaman the gloria of God!

(Bésame bajo the anuncios luminosos O God)

KODAK TROPICAL RADIO F&C REYES

in muchos colores

deletrean your Nombre.

“Transmiten

the noticia…”

Otro significado

no it conozco

the crueldades of esas luces no the defiendo

and si he of dar a testimonio sobre my época

is éste: Fue bárbara and primitiva

but poética.

translation.title: In the afternoon are sweet the neons...
